site.title: Below the Bloom
creed: Explore the world. Uncover the truth.
site.artAlt: Below the Bloom — a drowned colossus stands over a violet trench while a serpent and a winged scavenger watch

scenes.title: Deep Space Research Vessel
scenes.synopsis: Banter in orbit turns to sirens as a violet pulse rises off the ocean and drags the ship down.

scenes.title: Crashed Ship
scenes.synopsis: Oyster wakes to a dead crew and a glow in the water. He and Chip choose the castle over the wreck.

scenes.title: Shallow Waters
scenes.synopsis: A bioluminescent reef ends at a trench edge that swallows every reading they have.

scenes.title: Pitch Black Zone
scenes.synopsis: First contact with a berserker Froststalker. Oyster learns what the dark is holding.

scenes.title: Shortly After the Fight
scenes.synopsis: A hunting pack passes them by — something has the Froststalkers scared. The icy trenches appear.

scenes.title: Edge of the Icey Trenches
scenes.synopsis: Two sentries attack. Oyster improvises a blade from a severed fin and survives on instinct.

scenes.title: Icey Trenches
scenes.synopsis: Deeper into frozen canyons, where the kingdom's structures start to look deliberate.

scenes.title: Froststalker Cave
scenes.synopsis: Captured. The pair are taken into the heart of the ice.

scenes.title: Holding Cave
scenes.synopsis: Imprisoned and unarmed, Oyster and Chip take stock of a very short list of options.

scenes.title: Underwater Cave
scenes.synopsis: The kingdom moves around them in the dark, indifferent and enormous.

scenes.title: Cave Prison
scenes.synopsis: Screams echo down the tunnel. Something is inside the nursery that should not be.

scenes.title: Deep Cavern Chamber
scenes.synopsis: The Froststalker King finds his cubs alive and a dead Maw behind two strangers. Prisoners become guests.

scenes.title: Cave Cell
scenes.synopsis: The cell door stays open. Oyster and Chip try to understand what just happened to them.

scenes.title: Outer Trenches
scenes.synopsis: A society in the ice — nests, salvage crews, cubs. Every assumption they arrived with quietly dies.

scenes.title: Edge of the Trenches
scenes.synopsis: Farewells at the border. Beyond the frost, the map runs out.

scenes.title: Descending into the Depths
scenes.synopsis: The long fall. Pressure builds, light dies, and the purple glow stops answering.

scenes.title: The Ambush in the Dark
scenes.synopsis: An electromagnetic spike blinds Chip. Something with orange eyes separates them.

scenes.title: Cavernous Depths
scenes.synopsis: Alone in the black, Oyster is hunted through the caverns.

scenes.title: Twilight Corridor
scenes.synopsis: Dragged inward through corridors lit by sick purple light.

scenes.title: Maw Throne Room
scenes.synopsis: The Maw King speaks fluent English and offers Oyster a choice between a fast death and a slow one.

scenes.title: The Blade
scenes.synopsis: The King takes Oyster's right hand — then lets him run, because the running is the entertainment.

scenes.title: Twisting Tunnels
scenes.synopsis: Bleeding and one-handed, Oyster runs a maze that is being closed behind him.

scenes.title: Dead End
scenes.synopsis: Cornered — until a blaster clatters at his feet and Chip's voice comes out of the ceiling.

scenes.title: Just After the Reunion
scenes.synopsis: Chip opens like a toolbox and hands Oyster a new hand. Neural-link capable. Bottle opener included.

scenes.title: Deeper Ocean Trench
scenes.synopsis: Out of Maw country and still going down, following a purple thread through the water.

scenes.title: New Biome
scenes.synopsis: A layer of the ocean that behaves like nowhere above it. Time stops meaning much.

scenes.title: The Lighted Area
scenes.synopsis: Oyster stabs dinner. Dinner becomes an Emergent the size of an iceberg.

scenes.title: Alliance Beneath the Waves
scenes.synopsis: Two kings, once enemies, now allied — and a warning about what lives below even them.

scenes.title: Purple Paradise and the Deadwake
scenes.synopsis: The most beautiful place they have seen kills the fastest. Poison in the water calls a dozen more.

scenes.title: The Deadwake Encounter
scenes.synopsis: Surrounded and bleeding, they are collected by the Deadwake Queen herself.

scenes.title: Throne Chamber
scenes.synopsis: The Queen's terms: lead five royal guards into the Emergent kingdom, or do not leave.

scenes.title: Emergent Kingdom
scenes.synopsis: Oyster breaks the deal out loud. The Queen answers with war.

scenes.title: Battlefield
scenes.synopsis: Frost, Emergent and Deadwake collide in open water.

scenes.title: Battlefield Montage
scenes.synopsis: The war seen in fragments — no side winning, everything losing.

scenes.title: Battlefield Center
scenes.synopsis: In the middle of the killing, the water goes still. Something is watching from underneath.

scenes.title: The Purple Land
scenes.synopsis: “I do not command this world. I am this world.” The Bloom introduces itself and raises the fallen.

scenes.title: Glowing Depths
scenes.synopsis: The Bloom explains the food chain as scripture: the Emergent rises, the Maw consumes, the Frost stalks, the Deadwake waits.

scenes.title: The Purple Realm
scenes.synopsis: The rules of the game: beat a creature and it joins you. The kings come last.

scenes.title: The Game Progresses
scenes.synopsis: Wave after wave. Their side grows. Some of it dies.

scenes.title: Froststalker King Arrival
scenes.synopsis: The first crown steps into the arena.

scenes.title: Maw King Stage
scenes.synopsis: The hand-taker, face to face, with nothing between them.

scenes.title: Emergent King Stage
scenes.synopsis: The oldest thing in the ocean, made to fight the only people who were kind to it.

scenes.title: Deadwake Queen Entrance
scenes.synopsis: The Queen arrives last of the four, and she remembers being defied.

scenes.title: Center of the Abyss
scenes.synopsis: Four crowns at Oyster's back. One fish across the water. “The tide has always been mine.”

scenes.title: Bloom's Domain
scenes.synopsis: Clones, blades, betrayal and a self-destruct. The Bloom dies and takes three crowns with it.

scenes.title: The Gate to the Castle
scenes.synopsis: The gates open on their own. Two survivors say the quiet part to each other.

scenes.title: Castle Hall
scenes.synopsis: Statues of everything they fought. At the end of the row, something small and serene.

scenes.title: Castle Throne Room
scenes.synopsis: Squid welcomes them, thanks them, and takes their faces, their ship and their names.
